ambient: Something happens inside the note and doesn't disturb it.
It's joined by itself, at the same pitch, and stays one note.
description: One note, held, that everything else is happening inside. It has been going since before this and it isn't building to anything. The rest of the world is arranged around it and is quieter than it, and it isn't loud.
name: The Hum

looks: One pitch. No change in it anywhere.
It isn't coming from a direction. You have checked all of them.
It has been going long enough that stopping would be the event.
objects.name: the note

looks: Arranged inside it, and getting on.
Smaller than the note and going about its business.
It defers to the note and doesn't know that it's doing so.
objects.name: everything else
